blocks.en: Results
blocks.zh: 结果

blocks.en: A connectome-informed backbone separates reusable circuit organization from task interfaces
blocks.zh: 一个可连接的知情主干线将可重复使用的电路组织与任务接口分离

blocks.en: FlyVision implements a compact hierarchy in which two learned input branches process the image in parallel before information enters three recurrent graph-mixing stages. In the checkpoint-compatible two-dimensional implementation, each stage combines a feed-forward spatial operator, a gated recurrent operator and population-level interaction before normalization and nonlinear activation. The base model expands through 64, 128 and 256 channels to a 512-dimensional embedding; FlyVision Large uses 96, 192 and 384 channels with a 768-dimensional embedding. Global pooling and a task-specific head map the shared representation to the required output space. This design permits the recurrent and population-structured computation to remain stable while the number of input channels, spatial operator and prediction head are adapted to the dataset.
blocks.zh: FlyVision执行一个紧凑的分级,其中两个学习到的输入分支在信息进入三个经常性的相图混合阶段之前平行处理图像. 在与检查站兼容的二维执行中,每个阶段在正常化和非线性激活前,将一个向导的空间操作员,一个入门的经常性操作员和人口层面的互动结合起来. 基模型通过64道,128道和256道扩展为512道维嵌;FlyVision Lig使用96道,192道和384道维嵌. 全球集合和针对特定任务的头图,共享到所需产出空间的表示。 这种设计使经常计算和人口结构计算能够保持稳定,同时使输入通道、空间操作员和预测头的数量适应数据集。

blocks.en: The architectural separation is important for the cross-domain experiments. MNIST and CIFAR-10 use compact 2D instantiations, ImageNet-1K trains the same design at 224 × \times 224 resolution, and the radiography models load all 54 tensors from the ImageNet FlyVision checkpoints into checkpoint-compatible downstream reconstructions before replacing the 1,000-class classifier. BrainAGE likewise preserves the ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder and extends it to scan-level volumetric neuroimaging through multi-view analysis. Each three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI volume is represented by eight sagittal, eight coronal and eight axial slices; each slice is embedded independently, and slice-level predictions are fused within and across anatomical views. Figure 1 defines the connectome-derived design prior and cross-domain scope; Fig. 2 then details the conserved computational motif, capacity scaling across Compact, Base and Large variants, transfer progression and representative outcomes.
blocks.zh: 建筑分离对于跨域实验很重要. MNIST和CIFAR-10采用紧凑的2D即时设计,ImageNet-1K列车在224×xx\times 224分辨率的相同设计,射电模型从ImageNet FlyVision检查站将所有54个抗声器装入与检查站兼容的下游重建,再更换1000级分级器. BrainAGE同样保留了ImageNet所预先训练的FlyVision大型编码器,并通过多视图分析将其扩展为扫描级的体积神经成像. 每个三维T1加权核磁共振的体积由8个相片,8个冠片和8个轴片来代表;每个相片是独立嵌入的,切片水平的预测在解剖视角内部和之间被接通. 图1界定了连接体产生的设计之前和跨域范围;图2随后详述了节省的计算基数、跨契约、基数和大变体的能力规模、转移进度和代表性结果。

blocks.en: Compact recognition on MNIST
blocks.zh: MNIST的契约识别

blocks.en: MNIST [ 11 ] provides the simplest controlled test of optimization and parameter efficiency. Under the frozen benchmark protocol, FlyVision trained from scratch reached 99.34% top-1 accuracy and 99.33% macro-F1 with 80,608 parameters. ImageNet-initialized ResNet18 reached 99.38%, and scratch ResNet18 reached 99.22%, both with 11,181,642 parameters. Thus, FlyVision operated within 0.04 percentage points of the highest observed accuracy, while ResNet18 contained approximately 139 times as many trainable parameters. LeNet reached 98.60% and the MLP 97.50% (Figs. 3 and 4 ; Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: MNIST [11] 提供了最简单的优化控制测试和参数效率. 根据被冻结的基准协议,FlyVision从头接受训练的精度达到99.34%上到一的精度,99.33%的宏-F1有80,608个参数. ImageNet-初始化的ResNet18达到99.38%,抓取ResNet18达到99.22%,两者都有11,181,642个参数. 因此,FlyVision在观测到的准确度最高的0.04个百分点范围内运行,而ResNet18包含的可训练参数约为139倍. LeNet达到98.60%,MLP达到97.50%(图3和图4;表1)。

blocks.en: The comparison separates predictive performance from model size. LeNet is smaller than FlyVision but has lower test accuracy, whereas ResNet18 is substantially larger with only a small absolute increase over FlyVision in the best initialization condition. The result therefore identifies a useful operating point for the connectome-informed architecture in a low-resolution regime: high accuracy, compact parameterization and end-to-end trainability.
blocks.zh: 比较将预测性能与模型大小区分开来. LeNet比FlyVision小,但测试精度较低,而ResNet18则大得多,在最佳初始化条件下,与FlyVision相比绝对增长很小. 因此,该结果确定了低分辨率系统中连接体知情架构的有用操作点:高精度,紧凑参数化和端到端可列车.

blocks.en: Natural-image recognition reveals architecture-dependent transfer on CIFAR-10
blocks.zh: 自然图像识别显示CIFAR-10上的架构依赖转移

blocks.en: CIFAR-10 [ 12 ] introduces color, object pose, texture and background variation while retaining a compact ten-class setting. From scratch, ResNet18 reached 83.44% top-1 accuracy, FlyVision 78.03%, LeNet 70.87% and the MLP 52.60% (Figs. 5 and 6 ; Table 2 ). Direct ImageNet initialization increased ResNet18 to 85.84%, providing the highest observed CIFAR-10 accuracy in the benchmark.
blocks.zh: CIFAR-10 [12] 引入了颜色,对象姿势,纹理和背景变化,同时保留了紧凑的十级设置. 从零开始,ResNet18达到了83.44%的上至一的精度,FlyVision 78.03%,LeNet 70.87%和MLP 52.60%(图5和6;表2)。 直接图像网初始化将ResNet18提高到85.84%,提供了基准中观察到的最高CIFAR-10精度.

blocks.en: The paired transfer experiments show that source-task initialization is architecture dependent, consistent with prior evidence that feature transferability depends on source-target distance and the training regime [ 18 , 19 ] . MNIST initialization changed FlyVision from 78.03% to 77.62% (-0.41 percentage points; 95% CI, -1.22 to 0.40; Holm-adjusted exact McNemar P = 0.664 P=0.664 ). The same source initialization changed ResNet18 by -0.97 points (adjusted P = 0.034 P=0.034 ), LeNet by +1.84 points (adjusted P = 3.87 × 10 − 4 P=3.87\times 10^{-4} ), and the MLP by +1.10 points (adjusted P = 0.085 P=0.085 ). Direct ImageNet initialization increased ResNet18 from 83.44% to 85.84% (+2.40 points; 95% CI, 1.69–3.11; adjusted P = 2.49 × 10 − 10 P=2.49\times 10^{-10} ), whereas ImageNet-to-MNIST-to-CIFAR sequential initialization reached 84.04%. Thus, transfer effects vary with source task, target task and architecture.
blocks.zh: 配对的传输实验显示,源任务初始化取决于架构,与之前的证据表明特征可转移性取决于源目标距离和培训制度[18,19]. MNIST初始化将Flyvision从78.03%改为77.62%(-0.41个百分点;95% CI,-1.22改为0.40;Holm调整了精确的McNemar P=0.664 P=0.664),同一源初始化将ResNet18修改为-0.97分(调整后P=0.034 P=0.034),LeNet修改为+1.84分(调整后P=3.87×10-4 P=3.87\tims 10^{-4}),MLP修改为+1.10分(调整后P=0.085 P=0.085)。 直接成像网初始化将ResNet18从83.44%提升至85.84%(+2.40分;95% CI,1.69–3.11;调整后P=2.49×10-10 P=2.49\times 10^{-10}),而ImageNet-to-MNIST-至CIFAR相继初始化达到84.04%. 因此,转移效应因源任务,目标任务和架构而异.

blocks.en: ImageNet-1K establishes large-scale visual recognition
blocks.zh: ImageNet-1K 建立大规模视觉识别

blocks.en: ImageNet-1K [ 13 , 14 ] tests whether the FlyVision design remains trainable as image diversity and label cardinality expand. At 224 × \times 224 resolution, the selected validation checkpoints yielded 60.79% top-1 and 82.33% paired top-5 for FlyVision Base global surround (zero-based epoch 84), and 66.25%/86.07% for FlyVision Large global surround (epoch 82). Base local-k7 surround yielded 60.25%/81.93%. The corresponding 1,000-class global checkpoints contain 54 state-dict tensors and provide the initialization used in the downstream radiography experiments.
blocks.zh: ImageNet-1K [13,14]测试FlyVision设计是否随着图像多样性和标签的扩展而仍然可以被训练. 在224xxxxx224个解析度中,选定的验证检查站为环球Flyvision Base提供了60.79%的顶级-1和82.33%的对联:5(零基期84),为环球Flyvision大型(期82)提供了66.25%的86.07%。 本地-K7基地周边收成为60.25%/81.93%. 相应的1000级全球检查站包含54个国标分数,并提供下游射线实验中使用的初始化.

blocks.en: Independent evaluation of a later FlyVision Large local-k7 model with a learned low-frequency branch produced 66.53% top-1 and 86.31% top-5 on the 50,000-image validation set; this 3.744-million-parameter checkpoint initialized the skin-disease FlyVision run. Scratch-trained ResNet18 reached 69.25%/88.57% under the shared ImageNet launcher. FlyVision Base global, Large global and ResNet18 contain 1.836, 3.737 and 11.690 million parameters, respectively; their measured forward Conv/Linear operation counts are 6.632, 14.803 and 3.628 GFLOPs for 224 × \times 224 inputs (two FLOPs per multiply-accumulate). Thus, the ImageNet results separate parameter efficiency from computational cost: FlyVision uses substantially fewer parameters than ResNet18, while the recurrent and graph-interaction stages increase forward operation count in the profiled configurations (Fig. 7 ; Table 3 ).
blocks.zh: 对后来的FlyVision大型地克7型机车进行独立评价,在5万个图像验证组上,有学有学的低频分机产生了66.53%的上行-1和86.31%的上行-5;这个3744万个参数的检查站初始化了皮肤病FlyVision运行. 在共享的ImageNet发射装置下被刷新训练的ResNet18达到了69.25%/88.57%. 飞行视野 基础全球、大型全球和ResNet18分别载有1.836、3.737和11.69亿个参数;它们测量的远期Conv/Linear操作计数为6.632、14.803和3.628 GFLOP,用于224xx\times 224个输入(每乘积2个FLOP)。 因此,ImageNet的结果将参数效率与计算成本区分开来:FlyVision使用的参数比ResNet18要少得多,而经常性和相图交互阶段则会增加配置配置中的前期操作数(图7;表3).

blocks.en: Skin-disease imaging tests biomedical transfer outside radiography
blocks.zh: 皮肤病成像测试

blocks.en: Skin-disease classification provides a second two-dimensional biomedical setting with image statistics and label semantics distinct from natural photographs and chest radiographs. Image-based dermatologic classification has long provided a stringent test of visual representation quality because clinically relevant classes can differ by fine-grained morphology and color/texture cues [ 20 ] . The SkinDisease image collection contains 15,444 source images in 22 labeled classes. Exact-content screening and contradictory-label quarantine yielded a prepared image-level split of 11,506 training, 2,042 validation and 1,538 test images. The six selected evaluation exports contain identical test sample keys, true labels and class mappings. Across five FlyVision variants, held-out accuracy ranged from 58.45% (base local-k7) to 63.78% (Large local-k7 with a learned low-frequency branch), and one-versus-rest macro-AUROC ranged from 94.43% (base global) to 95.59% (Large global). ResNet18 reached 66.19% accuracy, 61.96% macro-F1 and 95.96% macro-AUROC. Table 4 reports all six models; Fig. 8 summarizes accuracy, macro-F1 and parameter count with 95% Wilson accuracy intervals.
blocks.zh: 皮肤-病症分类提供了第二个二维生物医学设定,其图像统计和标签语义与自然相片和胸腔放射图不同. 基于图像的皮肤分级长期以来为视觉表现质量提供了严格的测试,因为临床相关分类可以因细纹形态和颜色/纹理提示而有差异[20]. Skin Disase图像集包含有15,444个源图像,分出22个被标注的类. 精确内容筛选和自相矛盾的标签隔离产生了11,506个培训、2,042个验证和1,538个测试图像的预留图像分级。 6个选定的评价出口包含相同的测试样本密钥,真实标签和类映射. 5个FlyVision变体的预留精度从58.45%(基本地-k7)到63.78%(大量本地-k7有学有学有学的低频分支),1比2的宏AUROC从94.43%(基全球)到95.59%(大全球)。 ResNet18达到66.19%的精度,61.96%的宏-F1和95.96%的宏-AUROC. 表4报告所有6个模型;图8以95%的威尔逊精度间隔来总结精度,宏-F1和参数计数.

blocks.en: Across the six models, the most recurrent directional confusions were eczema classified as psoriasis (6–16 of 111 eczema images), tinea classified as eczema (8–17 of 98), and benign tumors classified as skin cancer (4–17 of 120). Because every model was evaluated on the same held-out images, these counts describe paired model behavior on a common test set. Figure 9 shows the highest-accuracy FlyVision configuration’s 22-class confusion matrix. The full matrices and classwise one-versus-rest AUROCs for all six models are included with the figure data. Five runs used resize/rotation jitter, whereas the Large local-k7/low-frequency run used spatial affine augmentation. Patient and lesion identifiers were not present in the available metadata; the prepared split is therefore image-level, and the reported estimates quantify held-out image-level generalization.
blocks.zh: 在所有6个模型中,最常见的定向混淆是被归类为黄道炎(111个黄道炎图像中的6至16个)、被归类为黄道炎(98个中的8至17个)和被归类为皮肤癌的良性肿瘤(120个中的4至17个)。 因为每个模型都是在同一被搁置的图像上被评价的,这些计数描述了一个常见测试集上的配对模型行为. 图9显示了最高精确度的Flyvision配置的22级混淆矩阵. 所有六种模型的完整矩阵和分级的AUROCs与数字数据一起列出。 5次运行使用了调整大小/旋转的颤抖,而大型局部-k7/低频运行则使用了空间等离子增强. 现有元数据中没有病人和损伤识别符;因此,准备的分解是图像层面的,所报告的估计数量化了持有的图像层面的概括。

blocks.en: FlyVision occupies a favorable accuracy-parameter regime on four-class chest radiography
blocks.zh: FlyVision在四等胸腔射线照相上采用了一种有利的精确参数制度

blocks.en: The chest-radiography benchmark used the public COVID-19 Radiography Database [ 21 , 22 ] , comprising 21,165 image-mask pairs: 3,616 COVID-19, 6,012 lung-opacity, 10,192 normal and 1,345 viral-pneumonia images. A deterministic class-stratified 70:15:15 image-level split produced 14,815 training, 3,175 validation and 3,175 held-out test images. The paired lung mask was applied in image space before ImageNet normalization.
blocks.zh: 胸射线基准使用公共COVID-19射线学数据库[21,22],由21,165个图像-面具对组成:3,616个COVID-19,6,012个肺-不透明,10,192个正常和1,345个病毒-肺炎图像. 确定性班级的70:15图像级分机产生了14,815个培训、3,175个验证和3,175个搁置测试图像。 成对的肺口罩在ImageNet正常化前被应用于图像空间.

blocks.en: On the held-out test set, FlyVision Large pretrained on ImageNet-1K achieved 92.76% accuracy (95% bootstrap CI, 91.83–93.66%) and 92.85% macro-F1 (91.84–93.91%). FlyVision Base achieved 92.60% accuracy (91.64–93.43%) and 92.75% macro-F1 (91.74–93.81%), while the same base architecture trained from random initialization reached 92.19% accuracy and 92.09% macro-F1. ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 reached 91.56% accuracy and 91.98% macro-F1; LeNet reached 89.80% accuracy and 89.83% macro-F1; the MLP reached 56.91% accuracy and 50.98% macro-F1 (Figs. 10 and 11 ; Table 5 ).
blocks.zh: 在停产测试中,FlyVision Larch在ImageNet-1K上的预训达到了92.76%的精度(95%的靴子CI,91.83–93.66 %)和92.85%的宏F1(91.84–93.91%)。 基地实现了92.60%的精度(91.64–93.43%)和92.75%的宏-F1(91.74–93.81%),而通过随机初始化培训的同一种基础架构达到了92.19%的精度和92.09%的宏-F1. ImageNet预装的ResNet18达到91.56%的精度和91.98%的宏-F1;LeNet达到89.80%的精度和89.83%的宏-F1;MLP达到56.91%的精度和50.98%的宏-F1(图10和图11;表5).

blocks.en: FlyVision Base contains 1.33 million parameters and requires approximately 1.28 GFLOPs per 224 × \times 224 image in the executed chest-radiography forward graph, compared with 11.18 million parameters and approximately 3.63 GFLOPs for ResNet18. Within this downstream benchmark, ResNet18 therefore has 8.44 times as many parameters and requires 2.83 times as many approximate Conv/Linear FLOPs as FlyVision Base, while FlyVision Base point estimates are 1.04 percentage points higher for accuracy and 0.77 points higher for macro-F1. FlyVision Large contains 2.97 million parameters and requires approximately 2.79 GFLOPs in the same chest-radiography profiler. These downstream operation counts use the radiography execution schedule, whereas the ImageNet values in Table 3 use the ImageNet schedule. Within this benchmark, FlyVision Base occupies a favorable accuracy-parameter and downstream-compute operating region (Figs. 10 , 11 and 13 ).
blocks.zh: FlyVision Base包含133万个参数,在已执行的胸射线前图中每224×\时需要约1.28个GFLOP,而ResNet18则需要约3.63个GFLOP. 因此,在下游基准内,ResNet18的参数为8.44倍,需要约2.83倍的Conv/Linear FLOPs与FlyVision Base,而FlyVision Base点估计精度高1.04个百分点,而宏F1则高0.77分. FlyVision Lige包含297万个参数,需要约2.79个GFLOP在同一胸射线剖面仪中. 这些下游操作计数使用射线学执行表,而表3中的ImageNet值则使用ImageNet表. 在这一基准范围内,Flyvision Base占据了精度参数和下游计算操作区(图10、11和13)。

blocks.en: Classwise analysis further resolves where errors remain (Fig. 12 ). FlyVision Base classwise F1 spans 0.898 for lung opacity to 0.958 for viral pneumonia, whereas FlyVision Large spans 0.904 to 0.954. COVID-19 sensitivity is 0.895 for FlyVision Base and 0.923 for FlyVision Large, compared with 0.862 for ResNet18. Across the stronger models, the largest residual ambiguity occurs between lung opacity and normal radiographs, while viral pneumonia is comparatively well separated.
blocks.zh: 分类分析进一步解决了仍然存在错误的地方(图12)。 飞行视野 基类F1的肺部不透明度为0.898至病毒性肺炎为0.958;而FlyVision Large为0.904至0.954. COVID-19的灵敏度为:FlyVision Base为0.895;FlyVision Lige为0.923;而ResNet18为0.862. 在整个更强大的模型中,肺部不透明与正常的放射图之间出现最大的残留模糊,而病毒性肺炎的分泌相对良好.

blocks.en: Hierarchical decomposition localizes the principal radiography errors
blocks.zh: 分层分解本地化主要射线错误

blocks.en: We reorganized radiography classification into two hierarchical formulations: a two-stage system that first separates normal from any disease and then classifies disease subtype, and a shared-backbone multi-head system with binary and subtype outputs. The flat FlyVision four-class model achieved 92.60% accuracy and 92.75% macro-F1. The two-stage hierarchy reached 91.53% accuracy and 91.68% macro-F1, and the multi-head hierarchy reached 91.75% accuracy and 92.17% macro-F1 (Fig. 14 ; Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 我们把射线学分类重组为两种分级配体:一种是双相系统,首先将正常与任何疾病分开,然后将疾病亚型分类,另一种是具有二进制和亚型输出的共享后骨多头系统. 平面飞行四等模型实现92.60%的精度和92.75%的宏-F1. 两阶段分级达到91.53%的精度和91.68%的宏-F1,多头分级达到91.75%的精度和92.17%的宏-F1(图14;表6).

blocks.en: The decomposition is most informative when the intermediate tasks are examined directly. Collapsing the flat model to normal-versus-disease yielded 95.02% sensitivity, 93.00% specificity, an AUROC of 0.9849 and an AUPRC of 0.9877. The dedicated disease-only subtype model achieved 95.02% accuracy and 95.58% macro-F1, while the multi-head subtype output achieved 95.57% accuracy and 96.09% macro-F1. End-to-end degradation is concentrated in the routing stage, while disease-only subtype discrimination remains strong. True normal images are most frequently routed toward lung opacity, identifying a specific error pathway that is obscured by aggregate four-class accuracy (Figs. 14 and 15 ).
blocks.zh: 分解在直接检查中间任务时最能提供信息. 将平面模型折叠为平面模型可产生95.02%的灵敏度,93.00%的特异性,AUROC为0.9849,AUPRC为0.9877. 专用疾病子型模式实现95.02%的精度和95.58%的宏-F1,而多头子型产出实现95.57%的精度和96.09%的宏-F1. 端到端的降解集中在通向阶段,而仅以疾病为主的亚型歧视仍然很严重. 真实的正常图像最常被引向肺部不透明,从而识别出一个被四级聚合精度所模糊的具体错误路径(图14和图15)。

blocks.en: Multi-view FlyVision extends the pretrained visual representation to volumetric brain-age regression
blocks.zh: 多视图 FlyVision 将预受训练的视觉表现扩展至体积脑年龄回退

blocks.en: The BrainAGE experiment applies the pretrained FlyVision Large image encoder to scan-level age prediction from T1-weighted structural MRI. The 2,851-scan cohort is drawn from the same 13 source neuroimaging datasets described below, with participant-grouped 70:15:15 partitioning used to keep repeated scans from one participant within a single split; the held-out test split contains 433 scans. Each T1w volume is represented by eight sagittal, eight coronal and eight axial slices sampled across the brain extent, with selected slices center-padded to a common canvas to preserve in-plane geometry.
blocks.zh: BrainAGE实验应用了被预先训练的FlyVision大图像编码器来从T1加权结构核磁共振中扫描等同年龄的预测. 2,851-扫描组取自下文所描述的同13个源神经成像数据集,参与者分组为70:15:15分区,用于将一个参与者的重复扫描保留在一个分数内;搁置测试分数包含433个扫描. 每个 T1w体积由8个斜拉片,8个冠状片和8个轴状片组成,在大脑范围内取样取出,并选取出切片中加到共同的画布上来保存平面几何.

blocks.en: Each of the 24 slices is encoded by the ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large backbone after strict loading of all 54 checkpoint tensors and removal of the original 1,000-class classifier. A slice-level regression head produces an age estimate and a learned confidence score. Within each anatomical axis, the confidence-modulated vote is multiplied by a Gaussian positional prior centered in the brain extent ( σ = 0.23 \sigma=0.23 ), normalized across the eight slices and used to obtain an axis-level age estimate. The final scan-level BrainAGE is the equal-weight mean of the sagittal, coronal and axial votes.
blocks.zh: 24片每片由ImageNet预装的FlyVision大型骨干在严格装入了所有54个检查站的分机后进行编码,并去除原来的1000级分机. 切片级回归头产生年龄估计和所学信心分. 在每个解剖轴内,置信调取的票乘以一个先以大脑范围为中心的高斯位置(=0.23\sigma=0.23),在8个切片间实现正态化并用于得到轴位年龄估计. 最终扫描级"大脑AGE"是"平分","冠状"和"轴心"等选票的等重平均值.

blocks.en: The three-axis fused estimate achieved a mean absolute error (MAE) of 5.98 years (95% bootstrap CI, 5.54–6.46), root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 7.67 years (7.11–8.30), R 2 = 0.868 R^{2}=0.868 (0.839–0.890), Pearson r = 0.931 r=0.931 (0.917–0.943) and Spearman ρ = 0.931 \rho=0.931 . The median absolute error was 4.94 years, and the mean brain-age delta was 0.02 years with a standard deviation of 7.68 years. The sagittal, coronal and axial axis-specific MAEs were 7.47, 7.44 and 7.49 years, respectively. Descriptive sex-stratified MAEs were 5.85 years in 234 female scans and 6.14 years in 199 male scans. The cross-view summary is shown in Fig. 16 ; agreement and age-stratified displays are shown in Fig. 17 and Table 7 .Descriptively, three-axis fusion reduced MAE by 1.45–1.50 years relative to the three individual-axis estimates.

blocks.en: Cross-task synthesis
blocks.zh: 跨任务综合

blocks.en: Across the study, the same circuit principle remains trainable from 28 × \times 28 grayscale digits through 32 × \times 32 natural images and 224 × \times 224 large-scale or biomedical images, and the ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large representation is reused across anatomical slices for scan-level brain-age regression from three-dimensional T1w MRI. The benchmark sequence resolves distinct properties of the architecture. MNIST establishes compact high-accuracy recognition; CIFAR-10 reveals that transfer depends on source-target compatibility; ImageNet-1K demonstrates scaling to 1,000 classes and supplies reusable pretrained checkpoints; skin-disease classification and chest radiography test two different biomedical image regimes; hierarchical radiography localizes routing errors; and BrainAGE extends the same pretrained representation to continuous prediction through multi-view aggregation. Across these settings, parameter count, computation, predictive quality and error structure provide complementary views of how the connectome-informed design scales.
blocks.zh: 在整个研究中,同样的回路原理仍然可以从28xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 基准序列解决了架构的不同属性. MNIST建立紧凑的高精确度识别;CIFAR-10显示转移取决于源目标相容性;ImageNet-1K显示可缩放到1000个类别并供应可重复使用预先训练的检查点;皮肤病分级和胸腔放射仪测试两种不同的生物医学图像系统;分级射线仪定位误差;BrainAge通过多视图聚合将同一预先训练的表示法扩展到连续预测. 在这些设置中,参数计数,计算,预测质量和出错结构为连接体知情设计尺度提供了互补观点.

blocks.en: Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论情况

blocks.en: ConnectomeX evaluates whether organizational principles derived from the Drosophila visual connectome can function as reusable architectural constraints for artificial vision. The central result is the persistence of one computational motif across progressively different regimes: compact digit recognition, natural-image classification, 1,000-class ImageNet recognition, two biomedical classification problems and a multi-view volumetric structural-MRI extension for BrainAGE. The architecture scales capacity while preserving parallel input pathways, recurrent processing and population-level interaction, allowing task performance to be interpreted in relation to a shared circuit design.
blocks.zh: 连接 X评价从Drosophila视觉连接体中衍生出来的组织原理是否能够发挥功能,作为人工视觉的可再使用的建筑限制. 其核心结果是,一个计算动机在逐渐不同的制度中持续存在:紧凑数字识别、自然图像分类、1 000级图像网识别、两个生物医学分类问题和BrainAge的多视积结构-MRI扩展。 架构在保持平行输入路径,经常性处理和人口级互动的同时,对能力进行分级,使任务性能能够被解释为与共享电路设计相关.

blocks.en: The low-resolution experiments distinguish compactness from transferability. FlyVision reaches 99.34% accuracy on MNIST with 80,608 parameters, placing it near the highest observed accuracy while using roughly two orders of magnitude fewer parameters than ResNet18. On CIFAR-10, scratch FlyVision reaches 78.03%, below ResNet18 but above LeNet and the MLP. MNIST initialization changes FlyVision accuracy by -0.41 percentage points, whereas the same source task improves LeNet and the MLP and direct ImageNet initialization improves ResNet18. This architecture-dependent pattern is consistent with the broader transfer-learning literature: feature reuse depends on both source-target relatedness and the representation learned by a particular architecture/training regime [ 18 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 低分辨率实验区分了紧凑性和可转移性. FlyVision在MNIST上达到99.34%的精度,有80,608个参数,使其接近观测到的最高精度,同时使用比ResNet18少了大约两个数量级的参数. 在CIFAR-10上,抓取飞行影像达到78.03%,低于ResNet18,但高于LeNet和MLP. MNIST初始化改变FlyVision精度为-0.41个百分点,而同源任务则改进了LeNet和MLP并直接图像网初始化改进了ResNet18. 这种依赖架构的模式与更广泛的转移学习文献是一致的:特征再利用既取决于源与目标的相关性,也取决于特定架构/培训制度所学得的代表性[18,19].

blocks.en: ImageNet-1K establishes the large-scale operating regime of the architecture family. Increasing FlyVision capacity from Base to Large raises top-1 accuracy from 60.79% to 66.25% for the global-surround models, and the Large local-k7/low-frequency model reaches 66.53%. ResNet18 remains higher at 69.25%, but with 11.690 million parameters versus approximately 3.74 million for FlyVision Large. At the same time, the profiled FlyVision models require more Conv/Linear operations than ResNet18, emphasizing that parameter efficiency and computational efficiency are distinct design properties. This distinction is important for connectome-informed networks because recurrence and population interaction can increase computation without proportionally increasing parameter count.
blocks.zh: ImageNet-1K建立了建筑家族的大规模操作制度. 从基站到大站的飞行能力提高,全球周边模型的上行精度从60.79%提高到66.25%,而大站地-k7/低频模型达到66.53%. ResNet18仍然较高,为69.25%,但有1 169万个参数,而FlyVision Large大约为374万个参数。 同时,被剖面的Flyvision模型比ResNet18需要更多的Conv/Linear操作,强调参数效率和计算效率是不同的设计属性. 这种区分对于连接体知情网络很重要,因为再现和人口互动可以增加计算而不会按比例增加参数数.

blocks.en: The two-dimensional biomedical experiments test transfer under different acquisition physics and label structures. The skin experiment extends image-based dermatologic classification into a 22-class setting [ 20 ] , whereas the radiography benchmark uses a thoracic imaging distribution and a distinct four-class label space [ 21 , 22 ] . In the 22-class skin-disease benchmark, FlyVision Large local-k7 with a learned low-frequency branch reaches 63.78% accuracy, 60.23% macro-F1 and 95.28% macro-AUROC with 2.992 million parameters, compared with 66.19%, 61.96% and 95.96% for the 11.188-million-parameter ResNet18. In chest radiography, ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Base and Large reach 92.60% and 92.76% accuracy with 1.33 and 2.97 million parameters, respectively, and both occupy a favorable accuracy-parameter regime relative to ResNet18. The radiography hierarchy further shows that disease-only subtype discrimination is stronger than the final four-class pipeline, localizing a substantial fraction of residual error to the normal-versus-disease routing decision.
blocks.zh: 不同获取物理和标签结构下的二维生物医学实验试验转移. 皮肤实验将基于图像的皮肤学分类扩展为22级设置[20],而射线学基准则使用胸膜成像分布和明显的四级标签空间[21,22]. 在22级皮肤疾病基准中,FlyVision Lig-k7具有学有学有学有学的低频分机的精度达到63.78%,宏-F1和95.28%的宏-AUROC具有2992万个参数,而11.88亿参数ResNet18的精度分别为66.19%,61.96%和95.96%. 在胸射线学方面,ImageNet预留的FlyVision Base和Lige分别达到92.66%和92.66%的精确度,参数分别为133和297万,它们都与ResNet18相比具有有利的精确参数制度。 放射线分级进一步表明,仅以疾病为主的子类型歧视比最后的四等管更强烈,将一大部分剩余误差本地化为正常与疾病路径决定.

blocks.en: The BrainAGE extension applies the same representation to a different prediction objective and to scan-level analysis of volumetric structural MRI. Brain age is commonly estimated by learning a mapping from T1-weighted neuroimaging to chronological age [ 15 , 16 , 17 ] . The BrainAGE model applies the ImageNet-pretrained FlyVision Large encoder independently to eight sagittal, eight coronal and eight axial slices, with the resulting age estimates combined by confidence-modulated Gaussian voting within each plane and equal-weight fusion across planes. On the held-out T1w test set, the fused prediction reached an MAE of 5.98 years and R 2 = 0.868 R^{2}=0.868 , compared with axis-specific MAEs of 7.47, 7.44 and 7.49 years. This design uses the pretrained two-dimensional representation for scan-level regression through multi-view aggregation of a three-dimensional T1w volume.
blocks.zh: BrainAge扩展将同样的表示应用于不同的预测目标,并扫描分解结构核磁共振的分层分析. 通常通过从T1加权神经成像到时间顺序年龄[15,16,17]的绘图来估计大脑年龄. BrainAGE模型独立将ImageNet所预置的FlyVision大型编码器应用到8个平面上,8个冠状和8个轴状片上,由此得出的年龄估计由每平面内置置信调节的高斯人投票和平面上平重聚变相结合. 在被搁置的T1w试验机组上,被保险的预测达到5.98年的MAE,R 2 = 0.868 R^{2}=0.868,而轴特定MAE为7.47,7.44和7.49年. 这种设计通过三维T1w体积的多视图聚合,使用预先训练的二维表示来进行扫描级回归.

blocks.en: The cross-domain results motivate direct component-level tests of the connectome-derived design. Sparse topology, recurrent pathways, ON/OFF segregation, population interaction and connection sign can be perturbed independently while matching parameter count and optimization budget. The benchmark suite provides quantitative reference conditions for such perturbations through aggregate performance, paired transfer effects, classwise errors, hierarchical routing, calibration and multi-view fusion.
blocks.zh: 跨域结果激励了连接体衍生设计的直接组件级测试. 平面地貌、经常性路径、ON/OFF隔离、人口互动和连接标志可以独立地被扰动,同时匹配参数计数和优化预算。 基准套件通过聚合性能,配对转移效应,分级误差,分级路由,校正和多视聚变,为这种扰动提供了定量的参考条件.

blocks.en: The data partitions define the level at which biomedical generalization is measured. The skin collection supports exact-content duplicate screening but lacks patient or lesion identifiers, and the public radiography release is evaluated with deterministic image-level stratification; both therefore report held-out image-level performance. BrainAGE uses participant-grouped partitioning so repeated scans from a participant remain within one split. Patient-, site- and scanner-separated evaluation would provide a complementary test of deployment-level generalization.
blocks.zh: 数据分区定义了计量生物医学通论的层次. 皮肤采集支持准确的内分量重复筛选,但缺乏病人或损伤识别器,公共射线片的发布通过定型图像分层来评估;因此,两者都报告被搁置的图像分层性能. BrainAGE使用参与者分组分割,因此参与者的重复扫描仍保持在一分之一. 病人、现场和扫描仪分开的评价将为部署一级的通用提供补充测试。

blocks.en: Taken together, the results establish a coherent interface between connectomics and machine learning: biological circuit structure supplies experimentally grounded architectural hypotheses, and cross-domain artificial-vision benchmarks provide a controlled setting in which those hypotheses can be scaled, transferred and perturbed. The resulting program treats the connectome as a source of testable computational structure, linking circuit organization to measurable properties of modern vision systems.
blocks.zh: 综合起来,这些结果在连通学和机器学习之间建立了连贯的界面:生物电路结构提供实验性的建筑假设,跨域人造视基准提供了一个可控环境,在这些环境中,这些假设可以被放大、转移和扰动。 由此而来的程序将连接体作为可测试计算结构的来源,将电路组织与现代视觉系统的可测量属性联系起来.

blocks.en: FlyVision architecture
blocks.zh: 飞行视野建筑

blocks.en: The checkpoint-compatible two-dimensional FlyVision implementation contains a dual ON/OFF stem, three recurrent graph-mixing stages, adaptive global pooling, an embedding layer and a task-specific prediction head. In the ON/OFF stem, the surround is the per-channel spatial mean over the full image (global) or a reflect-padded 7 × 7 7\times 7 local mean at each pixel (local-k7). The ON and OFF responses are ReLU ⁡ ( x − s ) \mathrm{ReLU}(x-s) and ReLU ⁡ ( s − x ) \mathrm{ReLU}(s-x) , respectively, for input x x and surround s s ; “+ LF” denotes a zero-initialized, learnable 5 × 5 5\times 5 stride-2 convolution of the local surround map added to the stem output as a low-frequency pathway. The ImageNet Base/Large implementation represented in Fig. 1 uses stage strides 1/2/2 after the stride-2 stem and one/two/two recurrent updates across S1/S2/S3. In the chest-radiography implementation, the same 54-tensor checkpoint schema is loaded into a downstream reconstruction with stage strides 2/2/2 and one recurrent update per stage. Because stride and recurrent-update count are execution hyperparameters rather than state-dictionary tensors, the checkpoint-compatible ImageNet and radiography models execute different forward schedules, accounting for the distinct GFLOP counts reported in Tables 3 and 5 . The chest-radiography base model uses two independent 3-to-32-channel 5 × \times 5 convolutions in the stem and stage widths of 64, 128 and 256 channels followed by a 512-dimensional embedding. FlyVision Large uses 3-to-48-channel stem branches, stage widths of 96, 192 and 384 channels and a 768-dimensional embedding. Each stage combines a feed-forward 3 × \times 3 convolution, a 3 × \times 3 recurrent convolution and a four-population graph mixer; learnable scalar gates modulate the recurrent and graph contributions, GroupNorm provides channel normalization [ 23 ] , and SiLU/Swish provides the activation nonlinearity [ 24 ] .

blocks.en: MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets

blocks.en: MNIST [ 11 ] contains 60,000 training and 10,000 test grayscale digit images. The benchmark reserves 6,000 images from the official training set for validation using a deterministic class-stratified split. CIFAR-10 [ 12 ] contains 50,000 training and 10,000 test RGB images across ten object classes; 5,000 training images are reserved for validation using the same deterministic stratified procedure. Dataset normalization statistics are estimated from the training subset only. CIFAR-10 training uses random 32 × \times 32 crops with four-pixel padding and random horizontal flips; validation and test transforms are deterministic.

blocks.en: MNIST/CIFAR-10 optimization, transfer and evaluation

blocks.en: All benchmark runs use 100 epochs, batch size 128, AdamW [ 25 ] with learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} and weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , cosine decay to 10 − 5 10^{-5} , and CUDA automatic mixed precision when available. FlyVision uses a gradient-clipping norm of 5 after AMP unscaling. Validation and test evaluation are performed in FP32. The checkpoint system stores model, optimizer, scheduler, GradScaler, random-number-generator state, DataLoader generator, history and protocol signature. Final reporting includes top-k accuracy, macro and weighted classification metrics, one-versus-rest AUROC, Brier score, expected calibration error, Wilson confidence intervals, inference timing and parameter counts.
blocks.zh: 所有基准运行都使用100个纪元,批量尺寸为128,亚当W [25] 有学习速率为10−3 10−3}和体重衰减为10−4 10−4},余弦衰减为10−5 10−5},有可用时CUDA自动混合精度. FlyVision在AMP解缩放后使用5的梯度剪接规范. 验证和测试评价在FP32中进行. 检查站系统存储模型,优化器,调度器,Grad Scale,随机数生成器状态,DataLoader生成器,历史和协议签名. 最终报告包括了上克精度,宏观和加权分类度量,一对后AUROC,布赖尔分数,预期校正出错,威尔逊置信间隔,推断时间和参数计数.

blocks.en: For CIFAR-10 transfer runs, compatible learned states are initialized from completed MNIST source runs and the target classifier is reset. ResNet18 is additionally evaluated with direct torchvision ImageNet-1K initialization and with ImageNet-to-MNIST-to-CIFAR sequential initialization. Scratch-versus-transfer comparisons use paired per-image predictions and exact McNemar tests with Holm adjustment across planned comparisons.
blocks.zh: 对于 CIFAR-10 传输运行,兼容的学习状态从完成的 MNIST 源运行中初始化并重置目标分类器. ResNet18还得到了直接火炬视像网-1K初始化和图像网到MNIST到CIFAR相继初始化的附加评价. Scratch-ter-transfer compare 使用对偶的每个图像预测和精确的麦克尼马尔测试,并配合霍尔姆在计划比较中的调整.

blocks.en: ImageNet-1K pretraining
blocks.zh: 图像Net-1K预训

blocks.en: The global-surround FlyVision ImageNet-1K checkpoints were trained from scratch on ImageNet-1K [ 13 , 14 ] at 224 × \times 224 resolution for 90 scheduled epochs with seed 1102. Their best-top-1 metadata are recorded at zero-based epochs 84 (base) and 82 (Large); ResNet18 is at epoch 89. The common single-GPU launcher uses batch size 128, AdamW (initial learning rate 10 − 3 10^{-3} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} ), five linear warm-up epochs and cosine decay to 10 − 6 10^{-6} , label smoothing 0.1, random resized crop, horizontal flip, RandAugment [ 26 ] , random erasing probability 0.1, ImageNet normalization, BF16 training and FP32 validation. FlyVision uses gradient clipping at norm 5; ResNet18 does not. The later Large local-k7/low-frequency run manifest records one NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU and the same recipe. Best-top-1 checkpoints are reported with their paired top-5 values; the later local-k7/low-frequency checkpoint was independently evaluated on all 50,000 validation images.
blocks.zh: 全球周边的FlyVision ImageNet-1K检查站在ImageNet-1K[13,14]上从头到尾接受了培训,在90个有种子1102的预定纪元上,以224×分224次解析. 其最顶级的一元数据记录在零基时代84 (base)和82 (Large);ResNet18记录在相去89. 常见的单相GPU发射装置采用批量尺寸128,AdamW(初始学习率10-3 10-Q-3},重量衰减10-4 10-X-4}),5个线性暖化纪元和余弦衰变为10-6 10-X-6},标签平滑0.1,随机调整收成,水平翻转,RandAugment [26],随机擦除概率. 0.1,ImageNet正常化,BF16培训和FP32验证. FlyVision在规范5使用梯度剪接;ResNet18没有. 后期的大型本地-k7/低频跑跑出表单记录了一款NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPU和同一种食谱. 据报告,最佳顶-一号检查站的配对值为前5;后来的当地-k7/低频检查站在所有50 000个验证图像上都得到了独立评估。

blocks.en: Skin-disease dataset and evaluation
blocks.zh: 皮肤病数据集和评价

blocks.en: The skin-disease benchmark used the Skin Disease Dataset published on Kaggle by Prashant Kumar Mishra [ 27 ] . The downloaded collection contained 15,444 images assigned to 22 source classes: Acne, Actinic Keratosis, Benign tumors, Bullous, Candidiasis, Drug Eruption, Eczema, Infestations/Bites, Lichen, Lupus, Moles, Psoriasis, Rosacea, Seborrheic Keratoses, Skin Cancer, Sun/Sunlight Damage, Tinea, Unknown/Normal, Vascular Tumors, Vasculitis, Vitiligo and Warts. The files were distributed in train/test directories organized by class; directory names served as the supplied labels, and the final split assignments are recorded in the packaged split manifest. The downloaded release did not provide patient or lesion identifiers or documentation of how the original labels were assigned; accordingly, the present benchmark quantifies image-level generalization. SHA-256 screening found 306 duplicate-content groups, 37 groups with contradictory labels and 63 groups crossing the original train/test boundary. The preparation code quarantined conflicting-label hashes, removed training copies of held-out test content, retained one representative per same-label hash, and created a seed-42 class-stratified validation subset from the remaining training pool. The prepared image-level split was 11,506/2,042/1,538 for train/validation/test; patient or lesion grouping was unavailable. All six evaluations used the prepared 1,538-image test split, 224 × \times 224 RGB images, ImageNet mean/standard-deviation normalization and a common 22-class index. The five FlyVision runs and ResNet18 used full-model AdamW fine-tuning with learning rate 10 − 4 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , batch size 64, seed 42, at most 100 epochs and validation-top-1 checkpoint selection. The base-global, base-local-k7, base-local-k7/low-frequency, Large-global and ResNet18 manifests record resize/rotation jitter; Large local-k7/low-frequency records spatial affine augmentation. FlyVision runs used gradient clipping at norm 5; ResNet18 did not. Initialization provenance was verified from the run manifests for analyses that specifically compare ImageNet transfer conditions; all six models contribute to held-out predictive benchmark summaries. Accuracy intervals are 95% Wilson intervals. For each class, AUROC was calculated one-versus-rest from the saved softmax probability column and binary true label; macro-AUROC is the unweighted mean of the 22 class AUROCs. Confusion counts use argmax predictions. The six prediction files were checked against the packaged test manifest and each other for identical sample keys and true labels. The six held-out prediction files are evaluated on the same fixed test set, enabling direct descriptive comparison of per-image errors and ranking metrics.
blocks.zh: 皮肤病基准使用由普拉尚特·库马尔·米什拉(Prashant Kumar Mishra)在Kaggle上发布的皮肤病数据集[27]. 下载的藏有15 444个图像,分给22个来源类:Acne、Actinic Keratosis、Benign肿瘤、Bullous、Candidiasis、Drug Eruption、Eczema、Infstatus/Bites、Lichen、Lupus、Moles、Psorias、Rosacea、Seborrheic Keratoses、皮肤癌、太阳/太阳光损害、Tinea、未知/自然、Vasculigo和Warts。 文件按类别排列在列车/测试目录中分发;目录名称作为提供的标签,最终分出任务记录在被包分出清单中. 下载的版本没有提供病人或损伤识别器,也没有提供原始标签如何分配的文件;因此,本基准量化图像层面的概括。 SHA-256筛选发现306个重复内容组,37个标签相矛盾的组和63个组跨越了原来的列车/测试边界. 制备编码隔离了相冲突的标签散列,去掉了被搁置测试内容的训练副本,保留了每个同名标签散列一名代表,并从剩余的训练池中创建了种子-42级分级验证子集. 所准备的图像分级为11 506/2,042/1,538,用于火车/验证/测试;没有病人或损伤分组。 所有6个评价都采用了所准备的1 538-图像测试分数、224 ×\times 224 RGB图像、ImageNet平均值/标准调整正常化和22等共同指数。 5个FlyVision跑道和ResNet18采用全型AdamW微调,采用学习速率10-4 10-QQ-4},重量衰减10-4 10-Q-4},批量尺寸64,种子42,最多100个纪元并进行验证-上-1检查站选择. 基-全球、基-地-克、基-地-克7、基-地-克7/低频、大-地-克和ResNet18显示的大小变化/旋转紧张; 大型地-克7/地-地-地-地-克、地-地-地-克7、地-地-克7/地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-克7、地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-克7、地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-克7、地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-克、地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-7、地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地-低频、地-地-地-地-地-地-地-地- FlyVision在规范5中使用了梯度剪接;ResNet18没有. 从运行清单中核实了初始化出处,以便分析具体比较ImageNet传输条件;所有六个模型都有助于预测性基准摘要。 准确间隔为95%的威尔逊间隔. 对于每个类,AUROC被从所保存的软马克斯概率列和二进制真标签中计算出一对一;宏-AUROC是22类AUROC的未加权平均值. 迷惑计数使用agmax预测. 6个预测文件与包装测试清单核对,并相互核对相同的样本密钥和真实标签。 6个搁置的预测文件在同一套固定测试中进行评估,从而可以直接对每个图像错误和排名指标进行描述性比较。

blocks.en: Chest-radiography dataset and split
blocks.zh: 胸射线学数据集和分拆

blocks.en: The radiography benchmark uses the COVID-19 Radiography Database [ 21 , 22 ] . The indexed release contains 21,165 image-mask pairs: 3,616 COVID-19, 6,012 lung-opacity, 10,192 normal and 1,345 viral-pneumonia images. Images are read as three-channel tensors and masks as single-channel tensors. A deterministic class-stratified split with random seed 2026 assigns 70% of images to training (n=14,815), 15% to validation (n=3,175) and 15% to testing (n=3,175).
blocks.zh: 射线学基准使用COVID-19射线学数据库[21,22]. 索引发布包含21,165个图像-面具对:3,616个COVID-19,6,012个肺-不透明,10,192个正常和1,345个病毒-肺炎图像. 图像被读取为三道收发机和口罩被读取为单道收发机. 以2026为随机种子的定级分出,将70%的图像分配到训练(n=14,815),15%分配到验证(n=3,175),15%分配到测试(n=3,175).

blocks.en: Chest-radiography preprocessing and optimization
blocks.zh: 胸射线学预处理和优化

blocks.en: Images and paired lung masks are resized to 224 × \times 224 pixels. During training, paired spatial augmentation uses left-right flipping, mild affine transformation and anisotropic resampling; intensity augmentation uses gamma variation, Gaussian noise and blur. Spatial transforms are applied jointly to image and mask with nearest-neighbor interpolation for the mask. The binary lung mask is applied in image space before ImageNet normalization. Validation and test images use deterministic resizing and masking without stochastic augmentation.
blocks.zh: 图像和配对的肺口罩被调整为224×\times 224像素. 在训练期间,对接的空间增强采用左向右翻转,温和的同位素转化和异同位素再生;强度增强使用伽玛变异,高斯噪音和模糊. 空间变换被联合应用于图像和口罩上,并配有近邻相接口罩的插值. 二进制肺罩在ImageNet正常化前被应用到图像空间. 验证和测试图像使用定型再大小和蒙面,不作有花样的增强.

blocks.en: Flat four-class models are optimized with AdamW [ 25 ] using an initial learning rate of 0.0003, weight decay 0.0001, five warm-up epochs and cosine decay to 0.000002. The loss is class-weighted cross-entropy with label smoothing of 0.05. Training uses mixed precision, a per-GPU batch size of 16 and a maximum of 200 epochs. Early stopping monitors validation macro-F1 with patience of ten epochs. Test metrics are computed from the saved best-validation checkpoint.
blocks.zh: 平面四等模型由亚当W[25]进行优化,采用0.0003,重量衰减0.0001的初始学习速率,有5个发热期和余弦衰变到0.000002. 损失为分级加权相交,标签平滑为0.05. 训练采用混合精度,每GPU批量尺寸为16个,最高为200个纪元. 早期停止显示器以10个纪元的耐心来验证宏-F1. 测试指标是从保存的最佳验证检查站计算的。

blocks.en: Radiography model initialization and baselines
blocks.zh: 放射图模型初始化和基线

blocks.en: FlyVision Base and FlyVision Large load all 54 tensors from the corresponding ImageNet-1K checkpoints before the 1,000-class classifier is replaced with a four-class head. The downstream reconstruction preserves checkpoint tensor shapes and parameter values and uses stage strides 2/2/2 with one recurrent update per stage; the ImageNet graph uses stage strides 1/2/2 with recurrent-update counts 1/2/2. The scratch FlyVision control uses this same radiography downstream graph with random initialization. Conventional comparators are LeNet [ 1 ] , an MLP and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet18 [ 3 ] . Parameter counts are measured directly from trainable tensors. Multiply-accumulate operations are measured from the executed radiography forward graph for a 224 × \times 224 input and reported as approximate GFLOPs using two floating-point operations per MAC. The reported radiography operation counts correspond to this downstream execution schedule; Table 3 reports the ImageNet schedule.
blocks.zh: 在1000级分类器被替换为四等头之前,FlyVision Base和FlyVision Large从相应的ImageNet-1K检查站装入所有54个对角. 下游的重建保留了检查站的收音机形状和参数值,并使用第2/2/2阶段的步道,每个阶段一次反复更新;ImageNet图则使用第1/2/2阶段的步道,反复更新计数为第1/2/2. 抓取"FlyVision"控制使用这个相同的放射线下游图,随机初始化. 常规参照物有:LeNet [1],一种MLP和由ImageNet预先训练的ResNet18 [3]. 参数计数直接取自可训练的开关。 乘积操作从已执行的射线前图中为224×\时为224个输入进行测量,并使用每个MAC的两个浮点操作报告为大约GFLOP. 所报告的射线学操作计数符合下游执行时间表;表3报告了ImageNet的时间表。

blocks.en: Hierarchical radiography models
blocks.zh: 分层射线模型

blocks.en: The two-stage hierarchy trains one FlyVision model for normal-versus-disease detection and a second model on disease-only images for three-way subtype classification among COVID-19, lung opacity and viral pneumonia. A hard-negative detector refinement oversamples difficult normal examples. The multi-head formulation shares a FlyVision backbone between binary and subtype heads. Detection thresholds are calibrated on validation predictions with a target disease sensitivity of 0.95. Final four-class predictions are reconstructed from the binary and subtype outputs and evaluated on the same held-out test split as the flat model.

blocks.en: BrainAGE cohort, preprocessing and multi-view voting
blocks.zh: 大脑组、预处理和多视图投票

blocks.en: The BrainAGE experiment performs scan-level age prediction from T1-weighted structural MRI. The 2,851-scan cohort is assembled from 13 source neuroimaging datasets: the Alzheimer’s Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI); the Brain Genomics Superstruct Project (BGSP) [ 28 ] ; Neuroimaging in Frontotemporal Dementia (NIFD/FTLDNI); the Southwest University Longitudinal Imaging Multimodal (SLIM) study [ 29 ] ; the Dallas Lifespan Brain Study (DLBS) [ 30 ] ; the Southwest University Adult Lifespan Dataset (SALD) [ 31 ] ; the Australian Imaging, Biomarkers and Lifestyle Study of Ageing (AIBL) [ 32 ] ; the Consortium for Reliability and Reproducibility (CoRR) [ 33 ] ; SchizConnect [ 34 ] ; IXI [ 35 ] ; OASIS-1 [ 36 ] ; OASIS-2 [ 37 ] ; and the Parkinson’s Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI) [ 38 ] . Data used in preparation of this article were obtained in part from the ADNI database ( adni.loni.usc.edu ). ADNI was launched in 2003 as a public–private partnership led by Principal Investigator Michael W. Weiner, MD. Its original goal was to determine whether serial MRI, positron-emission tomography, other biological markers, and clinical and neuropsychological assessment could be combined to measure progression of mild cognitive impairment and early Alzheimer’s disease; current goals include biomarker validation for clinical trials, improving cohort diversity and generalizability, and providing data on Alzheimer’s disease diagnosis and progression to the scientific community. For up-to-date information, see adni.loni.usc.edu . Participant-grouped 70:15:15 splitting with random seed 2026 keeps repeated scans from one participant within a single split; the held-out test set contains 433 scans. Sex is retained only for descriptive subgroup evaluation.
blocks.zh: BrainAGE实验从T1加权结构核磁共振中进行扫描级年龄预测. 2,851-扫描组群由13个源神经成像数据集组装而成:阿尔茨海默氏病神经成像倡议;脑基因组学超结构项目(BGSP)[28];前缘性畸形神经成像研究(NIFD/FTLDNI);西南大学纵向成像多模式研究[29];达拉斯生命体脑研究[30];西南大学成人生命体数据集[31];澳大利亚老年成像、生物标志和生命体研究[32];可靠性和再生性联合会[33];SchizConnect[34];IXI [35];OASIS-1 [36];OASIS-2[37];和Pakinsons的进步物标指标倡议[38]。 编写本条所使用的数据部分取自ADNI数据库(adni.loni.usc.edu)。 ADNI于2003年推出,由MD首席调查员Michael W. Weiner所领导的公私伙伴关系。 其最初的目标是确定是否可将连续核磁共振、正电子排放成像仪、其他生物标记、临床和神经心理评估结合起来,以衡量轻度认知障碍和早期阿尔茨海默氏病的进展;目前的目标包括临床试验的生物标记验证、提高组群的多样性和通俗性,以及向科学界提供阿尔茨海默氏病诊断和进展的数据。 关于最新消息,见adni.loni.usc.edu. 参与者组合70:15:15用随机种子2026分机将一个参与者的重复扫描保留在一个分机内;搁置测试集包含433个扫描. 仅保留性别用于描述性分组评价。

blocks.en: Preprocessing identifies the brain extent of each T1-weighted MRI volume and samples eight slices from each of the sagittal, coronal and axial planes between approximately 5% and 95% of that extent, yielding 24 slices per scan. Selected slices are center zero-padded to a common canvas to preserve native in-plane geometry, repeated across three channels and normalized for the ImageNet-pretrained encoder.
blocks.zh: 预处理鉴定出每个T1加权磁共振体积的大脑范围,并取出从每个平面上取取出大约5%到95%的平面上取出8个切片,每次扫描产生24个切片. 所选的切片是中央零加到普通画布上,以保留原生的平面几何,由三个通道重复并规范化为ImageNet预装编码器.

blocks.en: The model uses the FlyVision Large ImageNet checkpoint as a shared 2D encoder. All 54 checkpoint tensors are strictly loaded before the original classifier is replaced by an identity mapping, exposing the 768-dimensional embedding for each slice. A slice-age head consists of LayerNorm [ 39 ] , a 256-unit hidden layer with GELU activation [ 40 ] and dropout of 0.20, and a scalar age output. A separate confidence head uses LayerNorm, a 128-unit hidden layer with tanh activation and produces a scalar confidence score c i c_{i} for each slice. The complete BrainAGE model, including the shared FlyVision Large encoder and the age/confidence heads, contains 3.27 million trainable parameters. For normalized slice position p i p_{i} , the positional prior is g ⁡ ( p i ) = exp ⁡ [ − 0.5 ​ ( ( p i − 0.5 ) / 0.23 ) 2 ] g(p_{i})=\exp[-0.5((p_{i}-0.5)/0.23)^{2}] , and the unnormalized slice weight is g ⁡ ( p i ) ​ ( 0.05 + c i ) g(p_{i})(0.05+c_{i}) . Weights are normalized within each anatomical axis; the eight weighted slice-age estimates form one sagittal, coronal or axial age prediction, and the final scan-level prediction is the equal-weight mean of the three axis estimates.
blocks.zh: 该模型使用FlyVision大型图像网检查站作为共享的2D编码器. 所有54个检查站的分机在被身份映射所取代之前都严格地装入了原分类器,暴露出每个切片的768维嵌入. 切口-年龄头由LayerNorm [39]所组成,一个256个单元的隐藏层,带有GELU活化[40]并退出0.20,以及一个分级年龄输出. 一个单独的置信头使用LayerNorm,一个128个单元的隐藏层并有tanh活化,并且为每个切片产生一个scalar置信分C i c_{i}. 完整的BrainAGE模型,包括共享的FlyVision大型编码器和年龄/自信头,包含了327万个可训练参数. 对于已归正的切片位置 p i p {i} , 前面的位置是 g { (p i) = exp} [− 0.5 (p i − 0.5) / 6.23 (p → i ) 2] g (p → i ) + exp [- 0.5 (p → i )/ 0.23 → i }],非正常切入重量为 g → (p ) (0.05 + c i ) . 重量在每个解剖轴内实现常态化;8个加权切片龄估计形成1个斜向,冠向或轴向年龄预测,而最终的扫描水平预测是3个轴估计的等重平均值.

blocks.en: Training minimizes scan-level Huber loss [ 41 ] plus 0.25 times a Gaussian-weighted slice-level Huber loss, with a Huber transition parameter of 5 years. Optimization uses AdamW [ 25 ] , an encoder learning rate of 10 − 5 10^{-5} , a voting-head learning rate of 3 × 10 − 4 3\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 10 − 4 10^{-4} , five warm-up epochs followed by cosine decay, age-bin sample weighting, gradient clipping at norm 5 and automatic mixed precision when supported. Training uses batch size two per GPU for up to 120 epochs, with validation-MAE early stopping with patience 15.

blocks.en: Held-out evaluation reports MAE, RMSE, R 2 R^{2} , Pearson correlation, Spearman correlation, median absolute error and brain-age delta. Confidence intervals for MAE, RMSE, R 2 R^{2} and Pearson r r are estimated with 1,000 bootstrap resamples using seed 2027. Axis-specific, chronological-age-bin and sex-stratified metrics are reported descriptively from the same fixed held-out predictions.
blocks.zh: 被搁置的评价报告 MAE, RSE, R2 R^{2},皮尔逊相关,斯皮尔曼相关,中位绝对误差和大脑-年龄三角洲. 估计MAE、RMSE、R2 R^{2}和Pearson r r的置信间隔为1 000个靴子,使用2027个种子。 从相同的固定搁置预测中,以描述方式报告了具体轴向、时间顺序、年龄周期和性别比例指标。

blocks.en: Statistical evaluation
blocks.zh: 统计评价

blocks.en: For MNIST and CIFAR-10, top-1 confidence intervals are Wilson intervals [ 42 ] and planned scratch-versus-transfer comparisons use exact McNemar tests [ 43 ] with Holm multiplicity adjustment [ 44 ] . For chest radiography, confidence intervals for accuracy and macro-F1 are estimated from 300 bootstrap resamples [ 45 ] . For BrainAGE, confidence intervals for MAE, RMSE, R 2 R^{2} and Pearson correlation are estimated from 1,000 bootstrap resamples [ 45 ] of the fixed 433-scan test set. Primary radiography metrics are accuracy, balanced accuracy and macro-F1; additional metrics include classwise precision and recall, macro and weighted AUROC/AUPRC, Matthews correlation coefficient, Cohen kappa, log loss, multiclass Brier score and 15-bin expected calibration error. Cross-dataset comparisons are descriptive because the datasets differ in sample structure, target semantics and evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 对于MNIST和CIFAR-10,上一置信间隔为威尔逊间隔[42]并计划抓取与转移比较使用精确的McNemar测试[43]与Holm多重调整[44]. 胸部射线学方面,精确度和宏-F1的置信间隔估计从300个靴子回样[45]. 对于BrainAge,对MAE,RMSE,R2R^{2}和Pearson相关联的置信间隔估计从固定的433-扫描测试集的1000个靴子回样[45]. 初级射线测量是准确性,平衡性准确和宏-F1;额外的测量包括分级精度和回溯,宏观和加权的AUROC/AUPRC,Matthews相关系数,Cohen kappa,日志丢失,多级Brier分和15-bin预期校正出错. 跨数据集比较是描述性的,因为数据集在样本结构,目标语义和评价协议上有所不同.

blocks.en: Ethics and data governance
blocks.zh: 道德操守和数据治理

blocks.en: This study performed secondary analyses of existing image datasets and did not prospectively recruit participants or collect new human-subject data. The BrainAGE cohort uses source structural-neuroimaging data distributed by the originating repositories; use of those data remains subject to the governance, access and data-use terms of the respective repositories. The skin-disease benchmark uses the publicly accessible Kaggle dataset [ 27 ] ; the distributed files used in this study did not include patient or lesion identifiers, so patient-level grouping, linkage and re-identification were not performed. Restricted participant-level neuroimaging source or derived records are not redistributed by the authors.
blocks.zh: 这项研究对现有图像数据集进行了二级分析,没有预先征聘参与者或收集新的人主体数据。 BrainAGE群体使用原储存库分发的源结构-神经成像数据;这些数据的使用仍受各自储存库的管理、获取和数据使用条件的限制。 皮肤病基准使用可公开获取的Kaggle数据集[27];本研究使用的分布式文件不包括病人或损伤识别器,因此没有进行病人层次的分组,连接和再识别. 受限制的参与者级神经成像源或衍生出的记录不被作者重新分配.

blocks.en: Figure 1: Connectome-informed visual computation and cross-domain scaling. (A) Population-level schematic of the Drosophila visual-connectome prior. Representative neuronal populations are arranged across the retina, lamina, medulla, lobula and lobula plate. Solid arrows indicate sparse feed-forward projections between successive neuropils, curved arrows denote local recurrent processing, and red dashed arrows summarize inter-region feedback. (B) ImageNet-trained FlyVision Large backbone. The input is the dog image already shown in panel C. ON and OFF stem maps and stages S1–S3 show mean absolute activations across all channels from a forward pass through the trained global-surround checkpoint. Each map uses its own first–99th percentile display range; color intensity is not comparable across maps. Each stage has a feed-forward 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution and recurrent updates combining a 3 × 3 3\times 3 convolution with a signed four-population mixer, followed by GroupNorm, SiLU, lateral competition and a gated state update. S1/S2/S3 use one/two/two updates with shared weights. Global pooling, a 768-dimensional embedding and the ImageNet head produce 1,000 logits for this example. (C) Cross-domain scaling tests spanning MNIST, CIFAR-10, ImageNet-1K, skin-disease imaging, chest radiography and volumetric BrainAGE regression. BrainAGE is represented as multi-view analysis of a three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI volume: the model processes 24 slices across sagittal, coronal and axial planes and fuses them to a scan-level age estimate.

(B) 图像网训练的FlyVision大型骨干。 输入是已经显示在 C 面板 On 和 OF 干图以及 S1-S3 阶段的狗相图, 表示从经过训练的全球周边检查点的前进通道到所有渠道的绝对激活。 每张地图都使用自己的第一-99百分位显示范围;不同地图的颜色强度不相上下。 每个阶段都有一个Feed-forward 3×3 3 3\times 3 convolution和将一个3×3 3\times 3 convolution与一个签名的四人口混音器结合的经常性更新,之后是GroupNorm,SiLU,横向竞争和有门的状态更新. S1/S2/S3使用一/二/二更新并有共享权重. 全球集合,一个768维嵌入和ImageNet头为这个例子生成了1000个对数. (C) 跨域缩放测试,涵盖MNIST、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1K、皮肤病成像、胸光学和体积脑反射。 大脑 AGE作为三维T1加权核磁共振体体积的多视图分析来代表:模型会处理24片横跨地平面,冠状和轴状平面并把它们导出扫描级年龄估计.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Scaling the FlyVision architecture across tasks. (A) Conserved FlyVision computational motif. Parallel ON and OFF pathways feed three hierarchical stages (S1–S3), each combining a spatial operator, gated recurrence, population-graph interaction and normalization/nonlinearity before global pooling, embedding and a task-specific prediction head. (B) FlyVision architecture family. Compact FlyVision uses 16/32/64-channel stages and a 64-dimensional embedding for MNIST and CIFAR-10; FlyVision Base uses 64/128/256-channel stages and a 512-dimensional embedding for 224 × \times 224 inputs; FlyVision Large uses 96/192/384-channel stages and a 768-dimensional embedding. Parameter counts vary with the task interface, from approximately 80,000 parameters in the compact model to 1.33–1.84 million in Base and 2.97–3.74 million in Large. (C) Task progression and transfer. The study advances from MNIST and CIFAR-10 through ImageNet-1K, skin-disease classification and chest radiography to BrainAGE regression on a three-dimensional T1-weighted MRI volume. A shared FlyVision Large encoder processes eight sagittal, eight coronal and eight axial T1w slices; the age head predicts slice age, the confidence head supplies learned voting weights, and three-axis aggregation produces the scan-level estimate. (D) Representative outcomes across the architecture family, including paired ImageNet-1K validation top-1/top-5 accuracy of 60.79%/82.33% for Base global surround and 66.25%/86.07% for Large global surround, together with compact recognition, biomedical transfer and multi-view brain-age regression.
blocks.zh: 图2:跨任务扩大Flyvision架构. (A) 有保留的飞行影像计算方式。 平行的On和Off路径提供三个分级阶段(S1-S3),每个阶段结合一个空间操作员、有门重现、人口图互动和正常化/非线性,然后全球集合、嵌入和任务特定的预测头。 (B)飞景建筑家族. Concess FlyVision使用16/32/64相机和64维相机嵌入器,用于MNIST和CIFAR-10;FlyVision Base使用64/128/256相机和512相机嵌入器,用于224 x\times 224个输入;FlyVision大型相机使用96/192/384相机和768相机嵌入器. 参数计数因任务界面而异,从紧凑模型中的大约80 000个参数到基地的133-184万个参数和大号的297-374万参数不等。 (C) 任务进展和转让。 该研究从MNIST和CIFAR-10通过ImageNet-1K,皮肤病分级和胸腔辐射学,在三维T1加权核磁共振卷上推进到BrainAge回归. 一个共享的FlyVision大型编码器处理出8个平面,8个冠状和8个轴式的T1w切片;年龄头会预测切片年龄,置信头供给会学习投票权重,而三轴集合会产生扫描级估计. (D) 整个建筑家族的代表性成果,包括配对的ImageNet-1K验证顶端1/顶端-5的精度,基础环绕60.79%/82.33%,大型环绕66.25%/86.07%,以及紧凑识别、生物医学转移和多视脑龄回归。

blocks.en: Figure 3: MNIST held-out performance in the same overview format used for the larger classification tasks. Accuracy is plotted against macro-F1 for all benchmarked models on the common 10,000-image test set; horizontal bars show 95% Wilson confidence intervals for accuracy. Filled markers indicate scratch training and open markers transferred initialization. Marker radius is linearly mapped to trainable parameter count, with a small minimum for visibility; exact counts are reported in Table 1 .
blocks.zh: 图3: MNIST在较大分类任务中使用的相同概览格式的被搁置性能. 在常见的一万像测试集上,所有基准模型的精确度都会被以宏-F1来绘制;水平条显示95%的威尔逊置信间隔准确度. 被填入的标记表示抓取训练和被转移出初始化的开放标记. 标记半径被线性地映射为可训练参数计数,能见度最小;准确计数在表1中报告.

blocks.en: Figure 4: Compact recognition on MNIST. (A) Held-out top-1 accuracy with 95% Wilson confidence intervals for FlyVision and conventional baselines. (B) Accuracy plotted against trainable parameter count on a logarithmic axis. Scratch FlyVision reaches 99.34% top-1 accuracy with 80,608 parameters, placing it near the highest observed accuracy while remaining markedly smaller than ResNet18.
blocks.zh: 图4:卫生与信息技术部的契约识别。 (A) 有95%的威尔逊置信间隔,用于Flyvision和常规基线; (B) 精确度在对数轴上与可训练参数相比。 Scratch Fly Vision达到99.34%的上一分精度,有80,608个参数,将其置于观测到的最高精度之下,同时保持明显小于ResNet18.

blocks.en: Figure 5: CIFAR-10 performance across scratch and transfer conditions. Held-out accuracy is plotted against macro-F1 for all ten training conditions on the common 10,000-image test set; horizontal bars show 95% Wilson confidence intervals for accuracy. Filled markers denote scratch training and open markers transferred initialization. Marker radius is linearly mapped to trainable parameter count, with a small minimum for visibility; exact counts and initialization routes are reported in Table 2 .
blocks.zh: 图5:CIFAR-10在抓取和转移条件下的性能。 Hold-out精度在普通一万像测试集的所有10个训练条件上与宏-F1相比绘制;水平条显示95%的威尔逊置信间隔准确. 被填入的标记表示抓取训练和被转移的开出标记. 标记半径被线性地映射为可训练参数计数,能见度最小;精确的计数和初始化路径在表2中报告.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Natural-image recognition and transfer on CIFAR-10. (A) Test top-1 accuracy for models trained from scratch. (B) Transfer-induced change in top-1 accuracy relative to each architecture’s scratch baseline. Direct ImageNet initialization improves ResNet18 by 2.40 percentage points, whereas MNIST initialization changes FlyVision by -0.41 percentage points. The complete accuracy–macro-F1–parameter landscape across scratch and transferred conditions is shown in Fig. 5 .
blocks.zh: 图6:CIFAR-10上的自然图像识别和转移。 (A) 对从零开始训练的模型进行顶级-1精度测试。 (B) 与每个建筑刮痕基线相比,转移引起的顶一准确度变化。 Direct ImageNet初始化改进了ResNet182.40个百分点,而MNIST初始化则会改变Fly Vision的0.41个百分点. 图5显示了完整的精确度-宏-F1-参数地貌,横跨划痕和转移条件。

blocks.en: Figure 7: ImageNet-1K validation performance and model size. Validation top-1 accuracy is plotted against paired top-5 accuracy for the completed models. Bubble radius is proportional to trainable parameter count. FlyVision variants are shown in blue and ResNet18 in gray. Here LF denotes the learned low-frequency pathway described in Methods. The Large local-k7/low-frequency checkpoint was evaluated on all 50,000 validation images. Exact top-1, top-5, parameter and available operation-count values are reported in Table 3 .
blocks.zh: 图7:ImageNet-1K验证性能和模型大小. 验证顶-1的精度以完成的模型的对称顶-5的精度来绘制. 泡泡半径与可训练参数计数成正比. FlyVision变体以蓝色显示,ResNet18以灰色显示. 这里LF表示方法描述的所学取的低频路径. 对所有50 000个验证图像进行了大局部-k7/低频检查站的评价。 表3报告了精确的顶部-1、顶部-5、参数和可用的操作计算值。

blocks.en: Figure 8: Skin-disease held-out performance and model size. Test accuracy is plotted against macro-F1 for six models evaluated on the same 1,538 test images. Horizontal bars show 95% Wilson intervals for accuracy, and bubble radius is proportional to trainable parameter count. Global and local-k7 refer to full-image and 7 × 7 7\times 7 neighborhood surrounds, respectively; LF is the learned low-frequency pathway. Full per-image probabilities support the one-versus-rest macro-AUROC values in Table 4 and the directional confusion analysis reported in the Results.
blocks.zh: 图8:皮肤-疾病被搁置的性能和模型尺寸。 测试精度以宏-F1为标尺,用于在同一个1 538个测试图像上评价的6个模型. 水平栏显示有95%的威尔逊间隔的精度,而气泡半径与可训练参数计数成正比. 全球和本地K7分别指全相相和相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相邻相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 完全的逐象概率支持表4中的一对一的宏AUROC值和结果中所报告的方向混淆分析.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Skin-disease held-out confusion matrix for FlyVision Large local-k7 with the learned low-frequency branch. The 22-class matrix uses the same 1,538 image-level test samples as Fig. 8 ; rows are true classes and columns are predicted classes. Color indicates the percentage within each true-class row, while numerals give counts on the diagonal and for off-diagonal cells with at least five images. The accompanying CSV contains all cell counts and the paired per-image predictions. Overall accuracy is 981/1,538 (63.78%). The evaluation therefore quantifies image-level generalization.
blocks.zh: 图9:带有所学低频分机的FlyVision大型局部-k7的皮肤-疾病悬浮混淆矩阵. 22等矩阵使用与图8相同的1,538个图像级测试样本;行为真类,列为预测类. 颜色表示每个真类行内的百分比,而数字表示对角和对角外有至少5个图像的单元格的计数. 相伴随的CSV包含所有的细胞计数和成对的成像预测. 总体准确度为981/1,538(63.78%). 因此,评价将图像层面的一般化量化。

blocks.en: Figure 10: Chest-radiography held-out performance in the cross-task overview format. Accuracy is plotted against macro-F1 for six models evaluated on the same 3,175-image test set; horizontal bars show bootstrap 95% accuracy intervals. Marker radius is linearly mapped to trainable parameter count, with a small minimum for visibility. The five high-performing models cluster at the upper right of the full-range panel; the right panel labels and enlarges them using exact model coordinates and complete confidence intervals. The left panel retains the lower-performing MLP and the overall scale. Exact model size and performance values are reported in Table 5 .
blocks.zh: 图10:跨任务概览格式的胸射线学所保持的性能. 精确度与宏-F1相对应,用于在同一3,175-图像测试集上评价的6个模型;水平条显示出95%的精确度间隔。 标记半径被线性地映射为可训练参数计数,能见度最小. 在全程面板右上方的五个高性能模型集群;右面板标签并用精确的模型坐标来放大并完成置信间隔. 左侧面板保留了性能较低的MLP和整体比例. 表5报告了精确的模型大小和性能值。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Held-out chest-radiography benchmark. (A) Accuracy and macro-F1 for six models on the 3,175-image test set; horizontal bars show 95% confidence intervals from 300 bootstrap resamples. (B) Test macro-AUROC and macro-AUPRC. (C) Macro-F1 versus total parameter count on a logarithmic x-axis; vertical bars show the same bootstrap macro-F1 intervals. IN1K, ImageNet-1K pretraining.
blocks.zh: 图11:停放胸射线基准。 (A) 在3,175-图像测试集上为6个型号提供精确度和宏-F1;水平条显示从300个靴子回放中95%的置信间隔。 (B) 测试大型AUROC和大型AUPRC。 (C)宏-F1相对于总参数计算在一个对数x-轴上;垂直条显示相同的靴形宏-F1间隔. IN1K,ImageNet-1K预训.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Chest-radiography classwise behavior and error structure. (A–C) Test-set F1, sensitivity/recall and specificity for COVID-19, lung opacity, normal and viral pneumonia. (D) Representative confusion matrices for FlyVision Base, FlyVision Large, ResNet18 and MLP. Cells report observed counts and row-normalized percentages.
blocks.zh: 图12:胸辐射分级行为和出错结构. (A-C)测试-集F1,COVID-19的敏感性/召回和特异性,肺不透明,正常和病毒性肺炎. (D) Fly Vision Base、Fly Vision Lige、ResNet18和MLP的代表性混淆矩阵。 细胞报告观察到的计数和行正常百分比。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Chest-radiography performance-efficiency trade-offs. Held-out macro-F1 is plotted against (A) total parameter count, (B) approximate GFLOPs per image measured from the executed chest-radiography forward graph, (C) single-GPU inference latency and (D) single-GPU throughput. The FlyVision radiography operation counts reflect its downstream stride/recurrent schedule; Table 3 reports the ImageNet-forward counts. X-axes are logarithmic; vertical lines show 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for macro-F1.
blocks.zh: 图13:胸射线学性能-效率取舍. Hold-out macro-F1是根据(A)总参数计数,(B)从已执行的胸射线前图所测量的每个图像的大约GFLOP,(C)单-GPU推论纬度和(D)单-GPU吞吐. FlyVision射线学的计算反映了它的下游速度/经常时间表;表3报告了ImageNet向前的计算。 X轴为对数;垂直行显示为宏-F1的95%的靴子陷阱置信间隔.

blocks.en: Figure 14: Hierarchical chest-radiography analysis. (A) Disease-versus-normal sensitivity, specificity, F1 and AUROC for the collapsed flat classifier and hierarchical detectors. (B) Accuracy and macro-F1 with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the final flat, two-stage and multi-head four-class systems. (C) Corresponding test confusion matrices. (D) Validation sensitivity-specificity curves with selected thresholds and the target disease sensitivity of 0.95.
blocks.zh: 图14:分级胸射线分析. (A) 倒塌平分仪和分级探测器的疾病与正常的敏感性、特异性、F1和AUROC。 (B) 最终平面、两相和多头四等系统的精确度和宏F1,有95%的靴子置信间隔。 (C) 相应的测试混淆矩阵。 (D)验证敏感性特异性曲线,选定阈值和目标疾病敏感性为0.95.

blocks.en: Figure 15: Disease-subtype performance and radiography routing errors. (A) Accuracy and macro-F1 with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals for the disease-only stage-2 classifier and the multi-head subtype output. (B) Subtype confusion matrices. (C) Percentage of true-normal test images routed to each disease class by the flat, two-stage and multi-head systems. Blue, orange and green bars denote COVID-19, lung opacity and viral pneumonia, respectively; lung opacity is the dominant false-positive destination for true Normal images in all three schemes.
blocks.zh: 图15:疾病亚型性能和射线路线误差. (A) 对仅用于疾病阶段-2的分级器和多头子类型的输出,精确度和宏-F1具有95%的靴子置信间隔. (B) 子类型混淆矩阵。 (C) 按平面系统、两级系统和多头系统排列到每类疾病的真正常测试图像的百分比。 蓝条、橙条和绿条分别表示COVID-19、肺不透明和病毒性肺炎;在所有三种方案中,肺不透明是真实正常图像的主要假阳性目的地。

blocks.en: Figure 16: BrainAGE multi-view aggregation overview. The complete BrainAGE model contains 3.27 million trainable parameters. Axis-specific and three-axis fused predictions are positioned by held-out MAE and RMSE; the fused result is MAE 5.98 years, RMSE 7.67 years, R 2 = 0.868 R^{2}=0.868 and Pearson r = 0.931 r=0.931 on 433 held-out scans.
blocks.zh: 图16:BrainAge多视图汇总综述. 完整的BrainAGE模型包含327万个可被训练参数. 轴特异性和三轴引信预测由被搁置的MAE和RMSE定位;在被搁置的433个扫描上,被搁置的结果为MAE 5.98年,RMSE 7.67年,R 2 = 0.868 R^{2}=0.868和Pearson r = 0.931 r= 0.931.

blocks.en: Figure 17: Multi-view FlyVision Large BrainAGE regression. (A) Predicted versus chronological age for 433 held-out scans; the dashed diagonal denotes identity and the inset reports the primary regression metrics. (B) Bland–Altman representation of brain-age delta against the mean of predicted and chronological age. The solid horizontal line marks mean delta and dashed lines mark the 95% limits of agreement. (C) MAE for sagittal, coronal and axial axis-specific estimates and for final three-axis fusion. Each axis estimate aggregates eight native-scale slices using the Gaussian positional prior and learned slice confidence. (D) MAE across five-year chronological-age bins; sex-stratified MAE is shown descriptively in the inset.
blocks.zh: 图17 多视飞行大脑回归. (A) 对433个被搁置的扫描的预测年龄与时间年龄;破损的对角表示身份,套接字报告主要回归度量。 (B) Bland-Altman对大脑年龄三角洲的表示与预测年龄和时间顺序的平均值相对. 实心水平线标记指三角洲和虚线标记95%的协议限制. (C) MAE用于平面、冠状和轴向特定估计和最后三轴聚变。 每个轴使用高斯位置前和所学的切片置信度来估计出8个本土尺度的切片. (D) 跨五年时间年龄的MAE;性别等级的MAE在插件中以描述方式显示。
